name: Mechadog
pages: You may have spotted a few robotic dogs in the Martian labyrinth…

pages.text: Meet the Mechadog! This lil boi only spawns in the Mars dungeon, but, hey, do you want one of your own?
By defeating the hostile mechadogs in the labyrinth, you should start collecting some mechadog heads.  I wonder if they have a purpose…

pages: Once you've crafted a white one, try putting it back in the crafting table with a dye of your choice!  Collect all 16 colors!
The crafted Mechadog will be tamed to you, immediately, as soon as you place the item in the world!
